ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Finance or Supply Chain Management or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s).
